name: @avidia/entitlements
description: Plans, entitlements, and subscription normalization (M14): a pure, deterministic layer that answers WHAT a user may access given trusted server-side subscription state. Payments are NEVER client-authoritative - this package normalizes provider states (Stripe web, Apple/Google via a store abstraction) into one plan + capability + limit model consumed by both the SQL enforcement layer and the UI, so pricing/packaging can change without rewriting the application. Pure functions only - no database access, no network, no node built-ins - safe for the web bundle.
